description: The peer sends the first segment of an expedited ARQ C_PDU and, in the same transmission, regular ARQ data: the partial C_PDU is kept and our queued ARQ data waits. When the peer's next transmission carries regular ARQ data again, the partial C_PDU counts as abandoned: it is deleted, EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) is left and our data goes.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as dts-arq/expedited-rx-ack: the link is made at 57550 with the 16-bit family and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs. At 61000 one burst from the peer (3 blocks, EOT 30 on both D_PDUs) holds an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY (type 4), C_PDU ID 3, FSN 0 with C_PDU START and the first 4 bytes of a C_PDU (C-1008, C-1010), then a DATA-ONLY (type 9), FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, TX WIN UWE and LWE, with a DATA C_PDU 'data'. IDLE(CONNECTED) goes to EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0662); the type 4 C_PDU is partly received and a type 5 is owed (C-1210). The DATA-ONLY is processed in that state (C-0698): 'data' is delivered, cas.first_data stops (B-0215, B-0403) and an ACK-ONLY is owed. The type 9 is in the same transmission as the type 4, so the partial C_PDU stays (C-1231: a compliant peer keeps sending its expedited C_PDU, stop-and-wait, before it goes back to regular data). At 61500 the client sends 'abcd' by ARQ to 0.0.1.3 SAP 5: queued, and dts.ttd starts; in EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) the request is queued (C-0693) and types 9 and 11 wait while a type 4 C_PDU is partly received (C-0747, C-1215). At 88000 (csma.vdcd_end to 76000, contention 12000) our transmission carries the type 5 (RX LWE 1, no bitmap, EOT 20, C-0289, C-0291, C-1211), the ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 (EOT 20) and a copy of it in the rest of the second block (C-0882, C-1154); no DATA-ACK, since the data stays held. Placing the type 5 does not end the expedited exchange, because the C_PDU is still partly received (C-1212). At 106000 the peer's next transmission carries a DATA-ONLY, FSN 1, TX WIN UWE and LWE, 'more', and no type 4: it is in a later transmission than the partial C_PDU's last type 4, so the peer has abandoned that C_PDU (C-1231). The partial C_PDU is deleted with any type 5 still owed for it (as C-1214, C-0761), the exchange is over, and the node goes to DATA(CONNECTED), since regular ARQ has flowed (C-0738, C-1212); 'more' is delivered. The end of the exchange releases the held request (C-0737, C-1215): at 161000 (csma.vdcd_end to 116000, contention 45000) 'abcd' goes as a DATA-ACK merging the acknowledgement (C-1128): FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, TX WIN UWE and LWE, RX LWE 2, no bitmap, followed by an ACK-ONLY copy (C-1154); dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 runs from 171350. Without the abandonment the node would stay in EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) and 'abcd' would never be sent. At 181000 the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 confirms it: dts.ack_wait and dts.ttd stop (no confirmation was asked for). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap, a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes, an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY 18 bytes plus its segment, an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY 12 bytes plus its bitmap, a WARNING 12 and a PADDING 11. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). The peer is recorded Ed4, so spare room in a last block takes an ACK-ONLY copy or a PADDING D_PDU when one fits (C-0367, C-1154). The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
